note: Copilot & AI #6. Never run pac auth: pac solution unpack works on the local zip. After create-flow the owner exports the solution Loan reminders as unmanaged and saves it as LoanReminders.zip in the episode folder (never committed). The expression written by Copilot goes into expression.mylab.txt. A screen that needs a second capture of another kind lists it under 'then'.
prepare: # manual (owner): SharePoint site Contoso Facilities with list Equipment loans (Title = item, Borrower, BorrowerEmail, DueDate, Status Out/Returned) and three overdue rows for Alex Demo, Sam Demo, Robin Demo; Teams team Contoso Facilities with channel General; confirm the SharePoint, Outlook and Teams connections in Data, Connections

# manual (owner): Power Platform admin center, DEV: write down the region and the cross-geo setting; confirm labadmin has a licence that covers Copilot in the designer; rehearse the Copilot prompt once and delete what it created

screens.name: create-flow
steps: Select environment DEV, Home, Create with Copilot

Type the prompt exactly: Every weekday at 8:00, get the overdue items from the SharePoint list Equipment loans, email each borrower a reminder with Outlook, then post the number of overdue loans in the Teams channel General.
Show the suggested trigger and actions, then Keep it and continue
Show the connections step with green checks, then Create flow
Show the designer with the Copilot pane; Save, then add the flow to the solution Loan reminders (Solutions, Add existing, Cloud flow)
If the structure differs from expectations (extra condition, other trigger) keep it and say so
mask: SharePoint site URL in the trigger and address bar

screens.name: review-draft
prepare: if (-not (Test-Path ./LoanReminders.zip)) { throw 'Export the solution Loan reminders as unmanaged to LoanReminders.zip in the episode folder first' }
mask: unpacked folders contain connection reference names and the site URL: the output must not print them; stop and mask if it does
screens.note: If the real flow is cleaner than the sample say so: that is the result. If the flow file is not found pass the Workflows JSON path directly.

screens.name: expression
steps: In the designer add a Compose action holding utcNow(), then a second Compose
Click the second Compose field, select fx, then Create expression with Copilot
Type: Format TriggerDate to 'DD-MM' format (adapt the name to the real dynamic value)
Capture the expression Copilot returns, press OK, Save, Test with a manual or recent run, open the Compose output
Paste the returned expression into expression.mylab.txt for the terminal check

then.name: expression-terminal
prepare: if (-not (Test-Path ./expression.mylab.txt)) { throw 'Save the expression Copilot returned to expression.mylab.txt in the episode folder first' }

screens.name: troubleshoot
steps: Break the flow on purpose: in the Teams action point the channel at one the connection cannot post to (or break the list name), then Test
In the failed run open the red action and select Troubleshoot in Copilot (new designer)
Capture the error, Copilot's summary and its suggested fix; if the suggestion is wrong keep it

teardown: # manual (owner): delete the flow, the solution Loan reminders and run history you do not need; delete the SharePoint list, rows and Teams channel if created for this episode; put the cross-geo setting back to the written-down state
